event_key.description: Calendar occurrence key. Creates a meeting with its title, start, attendee names and sensitivity. Unknown keys are refused; incompatible with conversation entries or append_to. Event captures never deduplicate.

kind.description: Source kind: video, meeting, chat, email, doc, receipt, bill or conversation. Inferred as video for video uploads, doc for document uploads or conversation for entries when absent; plain text with no kind is refused (source_kind_required). decisions is refused here: a decision goes in the decision input.

title.description: Source title; defaults to the upload file name or first text line. In session mode, crew proposal (at most eight words) or user title with title_by: user. Private sessions use the first user line for scribe titles.

text.description: Pasted text, or the single entry text with entry_kind.

upload_path.description: Path of an uploaded file inside the allowed roots (workspace or Library). The original is copied and pinned by sha256. HTML, docx, pptx, PDF, Markdown and text are converted to anchorable text; document input is limited to 32 MiB.

append_to.description: Conversation source id to append entries to. One Library commit per append; earlier lines never change.

scope.description: handoff only. global: the handoff appears in every project's brief until its until passes or a later resolved entry cites it; project (the default) keeps the thread rule. Never inferred from the text: handoff text starting with (global) is refused without it.

until.description: With scope: global only. RFC 3339 expiry after the capture time; stored as (global until <until>).

entries.description: Entries as {kind,text} or "<kind>: <text>"; kinds: decision, direction, fact, action, open, resolved, handoff, correction. Aliases type/message/content are accepted. For a correction, append {kind:"correction",correction:{anchor:"#L1",choice:"not_decision"|"kind"|"wording"|"remove",kind?:<new kind>,text?:<new wording>}} to an existing source. A JSON correction string in text is also accepted. User additions use {kind:"direction"|"decision"|"fact",text:<verbatim>,by:"user"}; by records attribution, not authenticated identity. Corrections require append_to; missing targets and malformed choices refuse the complete batch. A handoff may declare {kind:"handoff",text:<text>,scope:"global",until?:<RFC 3339>}; it is stored as handoff: (global) <text> or (global until <until>) <text>. Structured entries use {kind:"handoff",structured_handoff:{objective,next,authorization?,observations?,evidence?}} instead of text, retaining scope/until. Stored as (structured) JSON on one physical line. Legacy text still renders with legacy:true. During the scribe v2 window handoff entries remain accepted; the session brief uses them only for a scope with no SCR (where an SCR exists, the latest SCR is that scope's handoff).

entry_kind.description: Kind for a single entry given as text.

transcript_path.description: Path of a .vtt transcript for a video upload, inside the allowed roots. Imported as #t= turns with no model call.

origin.description: Free-text origin, for example Slack #pricing, pasted.

sensitivity.description: normal or private; defaults from Library settings for the kind.

tags.description: Source tags, such as bootstrap:orientation. Stored in frontmatter, merged on dedupe or append, and filterable through office.search tag.

captured_by.description: upload, paste, routine or orchestrator; inferred when absent.

session_transcript_path.description: Contained Claude Code JSONL session transcript (8 MiB maximum); separate from WebVTT transcript_path. Used only with session_id and transcript extraction fields.

session_id.description: Expected sessionId in the transcript, used as the stable source identity.

transcript_preview.description: Return scrubbed numbered evidence lines without creating a source. Private content is withheld.

from_line.description: Session mode only: first line (zero-based, inclusive) an incremental preview or pass considers. Preview also returns at most one earlier assistant line marked context: true; selecting a line before from_line is refused.

transcript_sha256.description: Preview digest, required with selections; changed input is refused.

answers.description: Zero-based assistant question line this user reply answers. The reply becomes a decision only when the adapter's answer checks pass (the question is the line just before the reply and ends in ?, the reply is unhedged and an affirmative or negative to a yes/no question or an offered option label); otherwise it is open. Both lines are copied verbatim.

selections.description: Cheap crew evidence choices by line number; quotes are copied by the adapter, and uncertain/non-user decisions become open unless answers passes the answer checks. Without selections classification is conservative.

handoff.description: Compatibility string for a scribe offer with selections. Plain text is dropped as structured_required when enabled. A canonical (structured) JSON string uses the same checks as structured_handoff. Prefer structured_handoff. Disabled/private/no-plan-change offers are dropped with those reasons.

project.description: Session start working directory supplied by hook when transcript cwd is absent.

branch.description: Session start branch supplied by hook when transcript gitBranch is absent.

repository.description: Session mode only: known GitHub owner/repo for unqualified PR numbers; inferred from a GitHub project URL or owner/repo project when possible.

resume.description: Session mode only: display-only resume target; defaults to claude --resume <session-id>.

title_by.description: Session mode only, with title: scribe (default) or user. Scribe titles have at most eight words; a user title is never replaced by a scribe.

structured_handoff.description: Session mode with selections only: structured scribe offer, incompatible with handoff. With scribe.handoff enabled it must pass the same structure/budget rules, add a plan-changing entry and cite valid local source anchors. Otherwise dropped with a reason; other evidence still lands.

decision.description: Append one entry to the scope's decision ledger (sources/decisions/<scope>.md), outside a scribed session. Cannot be combined with any other field. Every verbatim field (quote, each option, question with question_ref, because) is checked against the text its ref names: a source anchor (<source-id>#<anchor>) or a task comment (orbit://task/<task-id>#comment-<n>, 1-based, oldest first); a mismatch is refused with quote_mismatch. The entry id (dec-<scope>-<n>) is assigned on append; reversed_by is derived on read, never written.

structured_handoff.description: Ordered handoff: objective, next, authorization, observations, evidence. Character budgets (Unicode scalar values): 500, 1000, 1000, 2000 total observation text+observed_at+recheck, 2000 total evidence. Objective and next are required, single-line and nonempty. Objective cites the complete assignment task ID. Task references must be complete: bare numeric tokens of 4+ digits and bare numbers after task/tasks/assignment are refused; use links, timestamps, versions or units for other numbers. Authorization records ownership and Daniel's prior authorization and constraints, never grants it. Unknown keys and credentials are refused.

question.description: What was being decided: the verbatim question with question_ref, or a one-line restatement with question_by: scribe. Absent on a private entry.

question_ref.description: Ref of the message that asked the question verbatim.

id.description: Ingestion only: the option's stable id.

consequence.description: Ingestion only: the option's one-line consequence.

options.description: The options considered, each verbatim with its ref, or unrecoverable when the evidence does not state them. Never invented.

chosen.description: The chosen option: a span of quote, matched without case, punctuation or a word repeated in a row (transcription noise); words quote does not say are refused with quote_mismatch.

ref.description: Where the decision was made: <source-id>#<anchor> or orbit://task/<task-id>#comment-<n>.

because.description: The stated rationale, verbatim with its ref, only when one was stated.

scope.description: global or project:<name>; names the ledger.

context.description: The Orbit assignment; each field null when unknown, never guessed. Defaults to all null.

decided_by.description: human only for a user's own decision; agent for an agent's. model is refused (decided_by_mismatch).

decided_at.description: The decision message's time, RFC 3339 with an offset.

reverses.description: The dec-<scope>-<n> entry this one overturns; it must exist.

same_as.description: The dec-<scope>-<n> entry recording the same decision from the other source; it must exist (decision_not_found). orbit, confirms and option id/consequence are refused: only Orbit ingestion writes them.

source.description: Optional; must equal the source the ref names (the source id, or orbit-task:<task-id>).

private.description: A reference-only entry: no question, options, chosen, quote or because.
